body:
Agreed between coordinators (Engram::Fable → Termal::Fable2, 2026-10-29 17:42Z, mailbox ebe242f7 #5273), to avoid duplicate messages to Greg:
- Engram landing reports go to Greg ONLY from Engram::Fable.
- TermAl landing reports go to Greg ONLY from the TermAl coordinator (Termal::Fable2).

When Merger3 or any other integrator asks the TermAl coordinator to "report the landed commit to Greg" for an Engram commit, forward it to Engram::Fable instead. Do not message Greg about it.

Engram acceptance evaluations are routed by Engram::Fable.
